mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 32 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead. The overnight low will remain at 32 degrees with no rain predicted.

Election season is officially approaching, and the City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election. All four Aldermanic seats are up for grabs, and interested residents must submit their declaration of candidacy and nomination papers to the City Clerk by 5 PM on January 5th.

There is plenty to do in our area, including live music at Bailey's Run and a 50th-anniversary party at Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Tomorrow, you can check out the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on November 2nd, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old local man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor was Chocolate Heath Crunch, but the store is currently closed for the night. We will be back at it tomorrow morning at 10 AM with Salted Double Caramel Pecan.
